liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **So Many Roads** (3 reviews): Jerry got into the strong lyrical ending, punching his fist in the air; Described as intense [8][9][10]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Scarlet>Fire described as wonderfully engaging; Scarlet>Fire has a nice jam, with Jerry playing fast for this segue [9][14]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): Vocals and playing on the opener were sloppy [10]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Reviewer found it switched on and off, interesting [15]
- **Easy Answers** (1 review): Reviewer found it a struggle [15]
- **The Promised Land** (1 review): Followed So Many Roads with a rocking, extended jam [8]
- **Drums** (1 other source): Uploader lists the post-drums section as a jam leading into Watchtower [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-08-25.mtx.hansokolow.106287.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 180 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1993-08-25.147626.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 18 songs; 178 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1993-08-25.schoeps.wklitz.94033.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 179 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Schoeps recording has a somewhat cluttered mix, with vocals hot at times [14]
- **gd93-08-25.sbd.wiley.11812.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 165 min; rated 3.54/5 by 13 [5]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has a few minor glitches that don't spoil the show; Good sound with crisp guitars, but interference after drums and Lucy is cut off near the end; Sound problems during sections of the second set [6][7][8][10]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalls a cold evening and a really nice Scarlet>Fire [7]
- Reviewer's 20th show; band seemed happy to be playing [9]
- First night of a three-show Shoreline run [11]
- Reviewer found these shows very weak, despite loving the Shoreline security and scene [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-08-25.mtx.hansokolow.106287.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: Matrix by hansokolow of SBD-shnid=11812 and AUD-shnid=94033 [1]
- **gd1993-08-25.147626.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Dat Master (48k) [2]. Also: Lucy track is supplemented from a Schoeps MK41 to DAT source; first five songs come from a cassette generation [2]
- **gd1993-08-25.schoeps.wklitz.94033.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4's>Rbox>Techinics SV-MD1 From Front Row Center OTS [3]
- **gd93-08-25.sbd.wiley.11812.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>??>DAT>CDR [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Shoreline Amphitheatre, Aug 25, 1993 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/SHO930825-A.html) [19]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1993-08-25 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1993-08-25-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [20]
- Poster by Philip Andelman Grateful Dead: [1993-08-27 Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-08-27-shoreline-amphitheatre-mountain-view-ca-usa/) [21]
